batch_056_060_details.speaker: Tan-chun
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Her questions proceed through costs, authority and workable arrangements. She can be wounded, angry and restrained in the same scene. In the quarrel she gives Aunt Zhao a face-saving exit, then insists on rank and procedure. Do not convert this into modern egalitarian management or permanent emotional coldness.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Bao-chai
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Learned teasing, practical restraint and privately generous action coexist. She distinguishes public appearance from private aid and actively controls who hears about the pawned coat. Her fiscal advice is not a secret engagement plan; her childish intimacy with Aunt Xue is real.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Patience
batch_056_060_details.guidance: She protects Xi-feng’s position while allowing Tan-chun’s reforms to succeed. Tact and authority do not eliminate hierarchy. Her reported command in chapter 59 must not be narrated as punishment already administered.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Li Wan and You-shi
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Keep Li Wan’s assent, practical participation and imperfect oversight distinct from You-shi’s reluctant mediation and competing obligations. Neither woman simply hands the household to Aunt Xue or disappears from management.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Bao-yu
batch_056_060_details.guidance: His tender solicitude, social privilege, panic, subsequent pretence and inventive protection are different actions. The initial illness is not a calculated performance. His private religious theory belongs to him, and his kindness does not make him understand every financial or labour consequence.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Nightingale and Snowgoose
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Nightingale moves from propriety and deliberate testing to urgent care and practical marital counsel. Snowgoose’s explanations and errands are not malicious disclosure. Their later author-chapter care provides continuity of diction, not knowledge of future illness.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Dai-yu
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Preserve the bodily force of distress, repartee, motherless grief and sympathy for Xiu-yan. Do not make every remark jealousy or turn all smiles into a mask. Her knowledge of the pawn ticket begins only with Bao-chai’s private explanation.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Grandmother Jia, Lady Wang and Aunt Xue
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Grandmother Jia’s alarm interrupts the physician’s formula and turns to matchmaking humour later. Lady Wang speaks through family authority and concern. Aunt Xue can soothe, tease and act practically; her proposed Bao-yu and Dai-yu match is not an announcement of a settled decision.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Doctor Wang and the nurses
batch_056_060_details.guidance: The physician’s diagnostic quotation, deferential answers and concern about fees have separate rhythms. Nurse Li’s alarming reaction worsens the panic; Nurse Song’s later watch is practical care. Historical medical language is neither a modern diagnosis nor endorsed advice.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Parfumée and the other actresses
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Parfumée’s pride, affection, anger, charm and cruel teasing coexist. Ou-guan’s grief and Rui-guan’s attachment are not generalized mischief. Ai-guan’s accusation contains an inference, and Kui-guan and Dou-guan have their own actions in the fight. Do not use one comic servant dialect for them all.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Aroma, Musk and Skybright
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Aroma mediates and supplies practical care. Musk invokes household rules and can recommend a contemptuous substitution. Skybright is sharp, changes sides in the washing dispute, urges dismissal and only pretends to stop the later fight while arranging intervention. None is a uniformly kindly modern carer.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Oriole and Swallow
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Oriole’s skill and playful refusal to surrender the willow branches become dangerous when her joke is believed. Swallow’s family account is frank, frightened and observant. Her description of future freedom is reported hope, not an accomplished change in status.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Mamma He, Mamma Xia and the paternal aunt
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Keep three people and their economic interests distinct. Mamma He’s violence turns to fear of losing her livelihood. Mamma Xia’s grievance over Ou-guan informs her incitement. The paternal aunt both guards flowers and later offers Oriole more. Avoid making all older women interchangeable villains.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Aunt Zhao, Jia Huan and Cai-yun
batch_056_060_details.guidance: Jia Huan accepts the lesser powder before his mother stirs the quarrel. Cai-yun recognizes it and tries to dissuade Aunt Zhao. Aunt Zhao uses rank, humiliation and abuse; those claims remain her own, without added slurs, caricatured dialect or narrator approval.

batch_056_060_details.speaker: Liu’s wife, Wu-er and Chan-jie
batch_056_060_details.guidance: The kitchen mother’s flattery and gifts seek a place for her daughter. Wu-er has her own ambitions, weakness and refusal of an unwanted match. Chan-jie resents favouritism and responds sharply. Requests, gifts, promises and actual appointment must remain separate.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Mrs Liu and the gate boy
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Use lively, abrasive spoken English with the actual sexual and bodily insults. Do not create a regional English dialect or make the cook a gentle comic mother. Her practical accounting and status flattery can coexist with abuse.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Lotus and Chess
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Lotus is provocative and adds to the story she reports. Chess's anger becomes a real command to destroy food. Preserve rank within the maid group and the distinction between threats, orders and completed acts.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Wu-er and Swallow
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Wu-er's fear and ill health do not erase her initiative or her lie. Swallow is a practical intermediary, neither an omniscient witness nor the giver of the original gift.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Patience
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Her warmth is coupled with tactical deception, protection of Tan-chun and concern for reputation. She handles rival claimants without disclosing every fact. Birthday modesty reflects her station, not lack of competence.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Xi-feng
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Keep the sharp punitive logic, suspicion of cover-ups and bodily exhaustion. Proposed torture is severe but unexecuted. Do not let Joker's later denunciation become her only narrative voice.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Aroma, Skybright and Musk
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Aroma cares and mediates while participating in the fun. Skybright's blunt challenges can be affectionate or destructive. Musk worries about observance and exposure. Preserve the difficult negative at 63.7 rather than making all three reassuringly benign.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Cai-yun, Jia Huan and Aunt Zhao
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Cai-yun's brave confession and devastated response deserve full force. Jia Huan's jealousy is not a proved affair. Aunt Zhao may console her while bearing responsibility for the earlier requests.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Tan-chun and Bao-chai
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Tan-chun enjoys play but respects delegated authority. Bao-chai's risk awareness, learning and affection do not make her an all-knowing expositor. Her views about women's reputation remain hers, alongside her own excellent literary criticism.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Bao-yu and Dai-yu
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Keep quick wit, intimacy, embarrassment and unequal knowledge. Bao-yu's kindness does not certify his economic or political judgments. Dai-yu's accidental hurt to Cai-yun is acknowledged, not turned into deliberate cruelty.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Xiang-yun and Caltrop
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Xiang-yun is exuberant and competitive, with expert knowledge and conspicuous mistakes. Caltrop's learning is eager and real; her naivety does not make her stupid. Her skirt anxiety concerns relationships and household rebuke as well as cost.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Parfumée and the actresses
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Parfumée is proud, energetic, theatrical and capable of puncturing Bao-yu's pomp. Male costume and names do not change the girls' sex or narrator pronouns. Distinguish her enacted song voice from her everyday speech.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Xiu-yan and Adamantina
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Xiu-yan can call her old friend eccentric while gratefully acknowledging her teaching. Adamantina's voice reaches the reader through a formal card and reported views, not an invented encounter.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: You-shi
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Her funeral decisions are capable and immediate. Her later unsuccessful resistance to the secret marriage is explicit. Neither kinship ambiguity nor a repeated family name should transport her into scenes where she is absent.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Jia Zhen, Jia Rong and Jia Lian
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Give each man his own mixture of desire, opportunism, bluster and evasive respectability. Retain coercion and misuse of hierarchy. Their compliments and Jia Rong's reports are not reliable narratorial endorsements.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: You Er-jie and You San-jie
batch_061_065_details.guidance: The elder sister's softness, hope and admitted past differ from the younger's combative manipulation, tears and demand for choice. Keep their contradictions and the narrator's judgments without sanitizing or romanticizing them.

batch_061_065_details.speaker: Bao Er's wife, the pages and Joker
batch_061_065_details.guidance: Use forceful obscenity at its actual intensity, including anatomical insults and the mother-directed threat. The pages' innuendo is not a licensed expansion into explicit acts. Joker performs for his new audience; retain his prejudice and flattery as speech.

batch_066_070_details.guidance: Let his first scene be irreverent, expansive and confidently speculative, with a servant's social vocabulary. Under interrogation his speech becomes deferential, defensive and pleading. Keep the physical threat and coerced explanation, without making every earlier observation reliable.

Give her a crisp reasoned defense of Bao-yu and a firm self-chosen vow, not generic coquettishness. Preserve her shame, decision and catastrophic act without moralizing narration beyond the source. Her dream speeches are heightened and severe, distinct from everyday conversation.

Gentleness is not absence of reasoning or agency. Keep her intervention to protect Liu, her gratitude and trust toward Xi-feng, her private self-reproach, despair and final acts. Do not recast everything as naive consent, nor assign her information she lacks.

Differentiate velvety conciliation, formal appeals to family authority, abusive public performance, private strategy and financial excuses. Long accumulative sentences can carry the staged torrent; short orders carry real power. Preserve her deliberate falsehoods, gendered abuse and coercion as speech/action, not translator endorsement.

Xue Pan's gratitude and grief are sincere in this scene even when his habits elsewhere are foolish. His mother's practical counsel and comfort remain familial and colloquial; do not make her accept factual certainty about the missing man that she does not have.

Keep the narrator's blunt 'not concerned' where stated, then her practical arrangements and tactful sociability. In poetry discussion she is analytically confident and deliberately transforms a supposedly unlucky subject. Do not infer either secret malice or a total authorial endorsement from those positions.

Move naturally between homesickness, restrained tears, literary gravity, quick jokes and physical fatigue. Her poems warrant full imagery and grief, but do not turn every catkin, kite or tear into a narrated prophecy about her later fate.

Preserve awkward tact in Liu's questioning, concern for Dai-yu, private response to poetry, alarm about schoolwork and playful incompetence with a kite. Do not universalize Joker's portrait or add modern psychological labels.

Aroma's household diligence and study prompting differ from Skybright's sharp sarcasm and Musk's mediation. Track who speaks each bee/wasp remark and who repeats a story. Avoid generic interchangeable maid chatter.

Patience’s compassion is constrained and discreet. Shan-jie’s refusal to fetch hair oil, defence of her mistress, and increasingly neglectful and abusive service must follow the local sequence; do not add initial kindness, a change of allegiance or testimony. Autumn’s combative boasting and sexual insult are coarse and aggressive; do not soften them or invent physical acts.

Keep warmth, rank and harsh dismissiveness when present. Grandmother Jia's funeral response is not sentimentalized. Lady Wang's criticism of cramming and concern about illness are simultaneous; Jia Zheng's absence is conveyed by letters and hearsay, not invented direct scenes.

Separate omniscient strategic narration from quoted accusations, medical opinion, astrological claims and proverbs. Professional labels should fit the historical function. Retain transitions and withheld information; do not add an essay explaining who is ultimately right.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Narrator
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Move from public ceremony to intimate disclosure without becoming an all-knowing explanatory commentator. Translate explicitly narrated motives, folly and social judgments, including discomforting gendered generalizations, while preserving reported claims as speech. Keep scene transitions and suspended chapter endings.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not erase source psychology under a general ban on interpretation; do not add motives, future outcomes or modern diagnoses.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Grandmother Jia
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Affection and domestic wit coexist with uncompromising authority. Her defence of Xi-feng and poor visiting girls is concrete; gambling punishment is severe. At dinner she relaxes service rules for her own pleasure; at moon-viewing she enjoys family jokes but feels the partiality jibe.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No uniformly cuddly grandmother; no omniscience about secret disputes before she is told.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Xi-feng
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Let outward courtesy, humiliation, proud defensiveness and physical exhaustion coexist. Her five-part defence needs a sustained logical rhythm. Jokes about money and the letter can cut; gratitude and tears are not all a single cynical mask.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not compress long defence, replace hypothetical suspects with proven culprits, or make her a cheerful modern administrator.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Patience
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Private frankness about illness, practical intervention and tactful concealment are different modes. She is modest toward the girls but authoritative toward servants. She protects reputations while arranging a specific remedy.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not turn tact into lying everywhere, certify her leak hypothesis or make her proposed money share a fee to Faithful.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Faithful
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Her access to Grandmother gives her authority, but she remains a servant. Shock at Chess’s secret gives way to empathy, an oath and admonition. Her joking with Jia Lian is guarded; her rice complaint is dry, domestic wit.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No moral prosecutor of Chess, no romance with Jia Lian inferred from loan help, no later84 fate imported.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Lady Xing
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Public charitable phrasing masks a challenge to Xi-feng; private criticism of Ying-chun is resentful and hierarchical. Her threat to Simpleton is blunt. Keep the stepmother relationship and grievance about the elder branch.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not make her the biological mother of Ying-chun or certify every accusation her servants feed her.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Lady Wang
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Shame, anger, piety and solicitous concern for the girls coexist. Her sudden hostility to Skybright is explicitly tied to appearance, recollection and denunciation. Her defence of the girls’ small staffs opposes Xi-feng’s economy proposal.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not soften threats into mild advice, or turn the narrative description of unmasked emotion into an invented diagnosis.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: You-shi
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Ceremonial competence, hunger, offended dignity, accommodation to servants and coarse private disgust vary by company. Her quarrel with Xi-chun moves from explanation and defence of Picture to wounded sarcasm and anger.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No generic timid or merely indecent caricature; do not make her certify the Zhen visitors’ business or the gambling claims.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Tan-chun
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Precise, strategic and increasingly angry. She links an affront to one sister to all their standing, summons help silently, then insists a search be acknowledged in words. The slap follows unwanted handling of her clothes. Her tears at internal collapse are not ornamental.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not anticipate a later political role or turn her speech into a modern manifesto; do not invert the slap sequence.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Ying-chun
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Pauses, lowered eyes, repeated appeals to let matters rest and retreat into reading should feel evasive and gentle without deleting her specific reasoning. She refuses to intercede when the others already failed and says she cannot deceive the seniors indefinitely.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not reduce every response to stupidity or invent consent to the theft.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Xi-chun
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Fright during the search hardens into insistence on detachment. Preserve repetitive refusal, moral quotations and her refusal to be implicated in Ning gossip. You-shi’s sarcasm and Picture’s pleas should press against that cold resolve.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No premature completed conversion or sainthood from85; no endorsement that harshness is spiritually correct.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Bao-yu
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Affection for the girls, anxiety before his father, selective literary enthusiasm, fear of examination and willingness to accept the sham illness all belong here. At the feast he weighs opposite risks of telling a joke.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not import81’s later grief or make him wholly ignorant of books; do not erase narrator’s explicit calculations.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Aroma and Musk
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Aroma placates an insulted mistress and later firmly tells Bao-yu to concentrate; Musk redirects his concern for her clothes back to his books. Their practical care is affectionate but not sugary.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not merge their speeches or make every line an expression of jealousy.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Skybright
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Sharp to sleepy juniors, resourceful in the fright deception, constrained before Lady Wang, and explosively dignified at the search. Her tears and strategic defence need their own rhythms.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not make the search prove sexual guilt, make the false sighting true, or sanitize her harshness toward juniors.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Chess and Pan You-an
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Chess’s terror, gratitude, anger at abandonment and later unashamed silence differ by scene. The letter is intimate but conventionally respectful; repeat its urgency and preserve the deferential signature. Pan is unnamed until the letter.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not fill in sexual actions or future outcome. Do not translate cousin as biological brother.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Cai-xia, her mother and Wang-er’s wife
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Wang-er’s wife flatters upward and disparages the parents; the mother agrees under pressure; Cai-xia separately fears the match. These voices must not collapse into mutual acceptance.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No happy arranged-wedding scene; no Cai-yun substitution; no husband substituted for the solicitor.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Jia Lian and Lin Zhi-xiao
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Jia Lian’s exaggerated courtesy solicits help; his joking, anxiety and shifts over the marriage show compromise. Lin’s warning about the son is tactful but concrete. The proposed estate reductions remain discussion.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not make the report of Yu-cun’s demotion certain or all proposed punishments enacted.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Mrs Wang Shan-bao and Zhou Rui’s wife
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Both exploit hierarchy and information, but at the search one is humiliated while the other joins the mocking chorus. Titles of respect can become barbs. Preserve the different roles and knowledge.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No merged generic old woman, no modern neutral investigator, no proof from accusation alone.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Jia Zheng and Jia She
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Jia Zheng awkwardly performs humour for his mother, then reasserts standards over poetry. Jia She’s joke suggests partiality and provokes a retreat; his praise of Jia Huan has a privileged, boastful ease.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: Do not treat either joke as autobiography or medical truth, or the inheritance boast as a legal transfer.

batch_071_075_details.speaker: Xing De-quan, Xue Pan and the boy favourites
batch_071_075_details.guidance: Drunken self-pity and coarse privilege dominate; the two boys use a rehearsed, economically dependent performance to soothe patrons. Render the source’s exploitation without voyeurism.
batch_071_075_details.avoid: No erotic expansion, invented consent, or added sexual action. Ages stay as stated; paid compliance is not free affection.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Grandmother Jia
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Genial insistence on fellowship turns to loneliness, tears and drowsy denial; preserve jokes, warm wine and practical attendants. Do not replace this arc with continuous solemnity.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Dai-yu
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Grief at being a guest shifts to learned competitive wit, admiration and sleepless intimacy. In79 she teases and corrects the elegy, then conceals alarm; the outward smile must not erase the inner reaction.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Xiang-yun
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Brisk consolation, learned confidence and gamesome rivalry. She praises Bao-chai's learning after complaining of abandonment. Not a consistently carefree foil.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Adamantina
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Intervenes with poetic confidence and a belief about destiny, then unusual hospitality. Her warning is opinion; her own continuation still contains cold, empty imagery.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Lady Wang
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Household authority, anxiety, selected justification and sincere conventional piety coexist. Preserve coercive orders and her diminishing account of Ying-chun's abuse as her words, not narrative endorsement.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Xi-feng
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Face-to-face practical interpretation of Bao-chai's departure; her guess is explicitly spoken to Lady Wang, not concealed thought.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Bao-chai
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Competent commercial explanation, courteous but firm withdrawal and practical protection of Caltrop. Do not turn tact into an omniscient confession of motives or modern liberation.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Bao-yu
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Helpless anger, fear of authority, suspicion, intense tenderness, fanciful consolation and wit. His purity hierarchy and omens remain his beliefs; do not flatten him into wise adult narrator or import81's knowledge.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Aroma
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Comfort, self-protection, hurt, sarcasm and effective care. Her private satisfaction at stopping grief is explicit, but proof of informing is absent. Preserve both; secret allowance does not narrate a wedding.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Skybright
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Breathless pain and fierce grievance, regretful counterfactual and unsparing intimacy. Keep unfinished words and coughing. No invented sexual consummation or chastity sermon.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Mrs Duo
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Bawdy, sexually assertive and testing, then protective. Keep tonal reversal without turning her into a maternal nurse or inventing intercourse.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Chess / Ying-chun
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Chess pleads and reproaches; Ying-chun grieves, cannot hold her and promises later intercession. In80 Ying-chun directly rejects resignation to bad fate; not simply a mute victim.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Caltrop
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Earnest literary hopes and confident sensory observation meet imposed submission and abuse. Her rejection of Bao-yu's warning is locally sincere; preserve her own voice beyond passive pathos.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Jin-gui / Bao-chan / Xue Pan
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Jin-gui shifts between strategic courtesy, staged suffering, threats and shrill invective. Bao-chan is proud and sexually interested within coercive hierarchy, later resists her mistress. Xue Pan's desire, appeasement and violence remain separate. Neither comic framing nor euphemism may erase abuse.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Jia Zheng / secretaries
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Official loyalism and exacting paternal critique differ from flattering chorus. His rebukes and occasional acceptance punctuate composition; do not combine poems into uninterrupted recital.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Two little maids
batch_076_080_details.guidance: First faithfully relays Mamma Song's near-death account; second improvises eyewitness story, last words, timing and deity to please Bao-yu. Keep them distinct and retain narrator's exposure.

batch_076_080_details.speaker: Wang One-Patch / Tealeaf
batch_076_080_details.guidance: Taoist's patter, failed sexual guess and escalating joke end in avowed fraud. Tealeaf understands and rebukes the guess; Bao-yu asks its meaning. Do not make all three knowingly complicit at once.
